summary.text: Yudelka Tapia is the Democratic nominee for re-election in NY Assembly District 86, a West Bronx seat she has held since November 2021. Born in the Dominican Republic, she holds a master's degree from Hunter College and worked as a Senior Auditor for the New York City Comptroller's Office. She serves on the Banks, Corporations, Economic Development, Housing, Labor and Mental Health committees.

paragraphs.text: Born in Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic; immigrated to the West Bronx more than 30 years ago and raised four sons there in New York City public schools.

Attended O&M University in Santo Domingo, where she organized fellow students against domestic violence and political corruption and served as president of the Unión Democrática de Mujeres, a national organization that organized and educated women.
Earned a Master of Science in Urban Policy and Leadership from Hunter College.
Worked for 23 years as a Senior Auditor for the New York City Comptroller's Office.
Served as PTA President at Roosevelt High School and as an Executive Committee member for the local 1407-DC 37 union.
Won the November 2, 2021 special general election for Assembly District 86, succeeding Victor Pichardo, and assumed office on November 3, 2021.
Re-elected to the Assembly in the November 2022 and November 2024 general elections.
Currently assigned to the Assembly's Banks; Corporations, Authorities and Commissions; Economic Development, Job Creation, Commerce and Industry; Housing; Labor; and Mental Health committees.
